```diff
@@
 Public Sub StopMonitoring()
     Set olInbox = Nothing
     MsgBox &quot;Email monitoring stopped!&quot;, vbInformation, &quot;Monitor Stopped&quot;
 End Sub
 
+&#39; Locate the IRM target store by display name
+Private Function FindTargetStore() As Outlook.store
+    Dim ns As Outlook.NameSpace
+    Dim st As Outlook.store
+    Set ns = Application.Session
+    For Each st In ns.Stores
+        If InStr(UCase(st.DisplayName), UCase(TARGET_ACCOUNT)) &gt; 0 Then
+            Set FindTargetStore = st
+            Exit Function
+        End If
+    Next st
+    Set FindTargetStore = Nothing
+End Function
+
+&#39; Get the IRM account (matching TARGET_ACCOUNT)
+Private Function GetIRMAccount() As Outlook.Account
+    Dim acct As Outlook.Account
+    For Each acct In Application.Session.Accounts
+        If InStr(UCase(acct.DisplayName), UCase(TARGET_ACCOUNT)) &gt; 0 Then
+            Set GetIRMAccount = acct
+            Exit Function
+        End If
+    Next acct
+    Set GetIRMAccount = Nothing
+End Function
+
+&#39; Get the default sending account (match default store, fallback to first)
+Private Function GetDefaultAccount() As Outlook.Account
+    Dim ns As Outlook.NameSpace
+    Dim defaultStore As Outlook.store
+    Dim acct As Outlook.Account
+    Set ns = Application.Session
+    Set defaultStore = ns.DefaultStore
+    
+    For Each acct In ns.Accounts
+        On Error Resume Next
+        If Not acct Is Nothing Then
+            If Not acct.DeliveryStore Is Nothing Then
+                If acct.DeliveryStore.StoreID = defaultStore.StoreID Then
+                    Set GetDefaultAccount = acct
+                    On Error GoTo 0
+                    Exit Function
+                End If
+            End If
+        End If
+        On Error GoTo 0
+    Next acct
+    
+    &#39; Fallback: first account if available
+    If ns.Accounts.Count &gt; 0 Then
+        Set GetDefaultAccount = ns.Accounts.Item(1)
+    Else
+        Set GetDefaultAccount = Nothing
+    End If
+End Function
+
 &#39; Get IPv4 address from system
 Private Function GetIPv4Address() As String
*** End Patch
```
